About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. https://www.thetrainline.com/terms/sustainability-faqs Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing Data Science & Analytics at Trainline👋    

Data Science & Analytics (DSA) is central to how we build products, delight our customers and grow our business. Our Data Scientists are embedded alongside Data Analysts in cross-functional teams which exist across product and marketing.  Data Scientists have a high degree of autonomy and are empowered to drive the success of their teams, using all data and techniques at their disposal.        

As a Data Scientist, you will be involved in driving insights and strategy for the product team, creating and measuring value through experimentation, creating focus through metrics and goals, and building deep learning about what is most impactful for each team.  You will be able to determine the underlying dynamics of our complex ecosystem and use this to deliver insights and strategic direction, but your main focus will be a complete obsession with driving impact within the product team, drawing on whatever analytical and statistical techniques that will unlock the most benefits.     

Data Science and Analytics at Trainline exists within the wider data organisation as part of the tech org, and is complemented by data engineering teams, data platform teams, and ML teams for when deep ML and AI techniques are required. Our autonomous model creates a huge opportunity for personal influence and impact – as the data scientist on the team you will be actively driving innovation on the team by contributing to strategy, execution and continuous learning.    



As a Data Scientist at Trainline, you will... 🚄    

As a Data Scientist in our New Business team, you'll help shape how Trainline grows beyond train tickets. From insurance and protection to hotels, car hire, attractions and other travel experiences, we're exploring new ways to add value throughout the customer journey, including making it easier for customers to plan more of their trip in one place. You'll use customer insights, experimentation and analytical techniques to uncover new opportunities, influence product strategy and create meaningful value for both our customers and Trainline.

As a Data Scientist, you will be responsible for influencing product and business outcomes, have the autonomy to make things happen and must obsess about having business impact. More specifically you will:   

 - Own data science work from start to finish within an embedded product team, from shaping the right question with your colleagues to delivering a solution and measuring its impact

 - Explore customer behaviour and product usage to uncover areas of friction, spot new opportunities and estimate the benefit of acting on them

 - Contribute to simple, seamless customer journeys by identifying where we can remove barriers and add value

 - Design, run and analyse experiments using sound statistical methods, and help define metrics

 - Build, test and improve models such as forecasting, personalisation or customer behaviour prediction that enhance the customer experience and support business growth

 - Turn your findings into clear, practical recommendations that help shape product and monetisation strategy, tailoring your message for both technical and non-technical audiences



We'd love to hear from you if you have... 🔍    

 - Hands-on experience applying data science to real product or customer problems, ideally within an embedded or cross-functional team

 - Confidence using Python and SQL to explore large datasets of customer activity, build models and write efficient, readable code

 - Experience of product engagement evaluation and measurement of success. For example, running A/B tests to evaluate product effectiveness or using front-end data to quantify the effectiveness of new features and how it changes user engagement.  

 - The ability to explain complex ideas simply and adapt how you communicate for different audiences

 - Ideally, an interest in monetisation, advertising, recommendations or e-commerce, and familiarity with tools such as dbt, Looker or Tableau, although none of these are essential

 - Tech Stack: SQL, Python, R, Tableau, AWS Athena + More! 



More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our Security team is dedicated to designing, implementing and monitoring the controls that keep Trainline resilient in a fast-evolving threat landscape. As part of our ongoing mission to mature Trainline's security capabilities, you'll help protect the digital channels that power billions of pounds in annual ticket sales, keeping our systems secure, resilient and ready for what's next.

As a Senior Product Security Engineer, you'll take ownership of product security across the development lifecycle, working closely with teams such as SRE and Platform Engineering to embed the latest tools and best practices into everything we build. You'll act as a trusted bridge between security, engineering and the wider business, helping to shape a culture where secure by design is second nature.

 - Define and own the product security roadmap, aligning priorities with business goals and influencing engineering leadership to embed security into how we design, build and deploy products

 - Establish and own the application security vulnerability management process, from triage and prioritisation through to remediation tracking, setting and reporting metrics such as mean time to remediate (MTTR) by severity and security testing coverage to give leadership clear visibility of risk

 - Work with teams across the business to carry out threat modelling for our web, mobile and API services, identifying risks and putting effective countermeasures in place

 - Assess the security posture of our applications and APIs through code reviews and static and dynamic security testing (SAST/DAST), and manage third-party penetration tests, from scoping with engineering teams and architects through to tracking remediation

 - Strengthen the security of our iOS and Android apps and the APIs that power them, covering areas such as authentication and authorisation, secure data storage, API gateway controls and protection against abuse and automated attacks

 - Implement, maintain and automate the security tools that support safe development and operations, from vulnerability scanning through to application security posture management (ASPM), and partner with engineering teams to fix vulnerabilities in ways that prevent them recurring

 - Build secure coding and deployment knowledge across the organisation through training and mentoring, including helping to establish and grow a security champions programme within our engineering teams

 - Ensure our product security practices align with relevant frameworks and standards, such as OWASP, NIST, ISO 27001, GDPR and PCI DSS, supporting compliance and audit efforts while monitoring emerging threats and finding ways to strengthen our resilience



We'd love to hear from you if you have... 🔍

 - Significant experience identifying, assessing and mitigating security risks across application design, code and deployed products, including setting up and running application security vulnerability management processes and reporting

 - Experience shaping and delivering a product or application security roadmap, with the confidence to influence engineering leaders and use metrics to demonstrate progress and risk reduction

 - Experience securing mobile applications and APIs, including testing iOS and Android apps and applying secure approaches to authentication and authorisation, such as OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect

 - Hands-on experience with security testing tools such as SAST, DAST and vulnerability scanning solutions, ideally including mobile app security testing and API security testing tools

 - Practical experience with threat modelling and security reviews, as well as scoping and managing third-party penetration tests in partnership with engineering teams and architects

 - A strong grasp of secure coding practices and experience embedding security into software development workflows, including implementing technical controls and driving automation within CI/CD pipelines, ideally across cloud-native, containerised and infrastructure as code (IaC) environments

 - Familiarity with industry standards and frameworks such as OWASP (ideally including the Mobile Application Security Verification Standard and API Security Top 10), PCI DSS, ISO 27001 and GDPR

 - It would also be helpful if you have experience setting up or growing a security champions programme, running risk assessments, or a working knowledge of regulatory compliance standards

As a fast moving FTSE 250 business, we're looking for an experienced and technically excellent Head of Group Reporting to join us on a permanent basis. It's a role that goes beyond a typical Group Reporting position, suited to someone who thrives in a varied, fast paced environment, is always ready to get involved, and loves learning new things. Our business changes daily, so we need someone who stays close to the operational side of things and can help us respond quickly and effectively.

Technical rigour is non-negotiable here. You'll be the go-to person for complex and judgemental accounting questions, expected to research positions thoroughly, form a clear view, and defend it with auditors and advisors, while translating that thinking into clear, accessible communication for senior non-financial stakeholders. You'll also bring commercial awareness, particularly around cashflow, liquidity and capital, along with the analytical instinct to spot when the numbers don't add up.

In this role as the Head of Group Reporting, you will...🚄

 - Take ownership of producing the Group's IFRS annual and half yearly listed financial statements and annual report.

 - Lead the year end and half year external audit and review processes end to end, keeping key stakeholders informed and preparing and presenting Audit Committee papers.

 - Oversee the production and filing of subsidiary statutory accounts across our UK and international entities.

 - Own the Group's cashflow forecasting process, providing insight and analysis on liquidity, capital allocation and capital structure to support CFO and Board decision making, working closely with treasury on execution.

 - Act as the Group's primary technical accounting authority, researching and forming well reasoned positions on complex and judgemental areas, implementing new standards, and presenting conclusions to senior management, the Audit Committee, auditors and advisors.

 - Build and support strong external relationships, including with auditors, loan providers and banking partners, and work closely with legal and CoSec to ensure reporting requirements are met on time.

 - Lead Finance's contribution to the Group's material controls framework under Provision 29, maintain and develop the Group's accounting policies including for acquisitions and legal structure changes, and guide reporting systems and process change to protect the integrity of our control environment.

We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍

 - You're a qualified accountant with significant post qualification experience, including meaningful time spent in industry within a listed business, and are comfortable with the reporting obligations and scrutiny that come with that environment; you have a consistent record of delivering to deadline.

 - You bring extensive IFRS expertise and a strong technical accounting grounding, confident researching and forming defensible positions on complex areas such as multi-currency consolidations, share based payments, EPS, impairment, revenue recognition, leases and business combinations.

 - If you're currently in practice, you'd be operating at Director level or above, with substantial experience advising listed groups on complex technical matters and be ready to step into a senior in-house leadership role.

 - You have experience researching and implementing new accounting or reporting standards.

 - You're analytical and thorough when reviewing financial information, quick to spot errors in accounting treatment or anomalies that don't add up.

 - You have proven people management experience, with a track record of leading, motivating and developing high performing teams across multiple disciplines.

 - You're an excellent project manager, organised in your own workload while confident delegating and developing others, equally comfortable working independently or as part of a team.

 - You're ambitious and driven, energised by a fast paced environment, always ready to get involved in team projects and try new things; it would be helpful if you're open to occasional travel to our Paris and Edinburgh offices.

In this role as the Mid-Level Web Engineer, you will... 🚄

 - Build and ship new features and improvements to the Railcard experience on the Trainline app, using React and TypeScript to create reliable, maintainable interfaces

 - Work with GraphQL and Node.js to connect front-end features to the services and data that power Railcard retention and loyalty

 - Take ownership of your work across the full development lifecycle, from writing code through to deployment and monitoring on AWS

 - Keep quality at the heart of everything you do, with a strong focus on testing and continuous improvement of the codebase

 - Keep the customer at the centre of every decision, understanding how changes affect their experience

 - Use A/B testing to explore different approaches and identify the most valuable solution for customers

 - Collaborate with product, design and other engineering teams to deliver work that fits into the wider Trainline app



We’d love to hear from you if you have... 🔍

 - Good hands-on experience with React and TypeScript, and enjoy building well-tested, reliable features

 - Experience working across the development lifecycle, from writing code through to deployment and monitoring

 - Strong testing practices and a genuine focus on quality in your work

 - Great communication skills and enjoy working within a collaborative, agile team

 - A proactive, supportive and honest approach to working as part of a close-knit team

 - Ideally some exposure to GraphQL, Node.js or AWS, or are keen to build experience with them

 - A curiosity for learning new skills and approaches as technology evolves
